ad.flavor: You saw some ads, so you get an ad. Collect these to flex on how much you support the devs via seeing ads.
ad.name: Freemium Ad

adventureticket.details: This ticket is used as an entry fee when you start the adventure command.
adventureticket.name: Adventure Ticket

adventurevoucher.details: This item is used as a component to craft adventure themed lootboxes!
adventurevoucher.flavor: Grandma printed me off this voucher for one free box!
adventurevoucher.name: Adventure Voucher

aetheryxflower.flavor: A decomposing red flower, a wisp of its former self.
aetheryxflower.name: Aetheryx' Flower

ahaspitcherplant.flavor: I tried pouring lemonade in the pitcher...
ahaspitcherplant.name: Aha's Pitcher Plant

aipheysgemstone.flavor: Aiphey's gemstone is a precious stone. It vibrates at a high frequency, creating a bubble of spiritual protection against negative energy. It is such a sacred and a rare stone, if you ever manage to get it, you must protect it at all costs.
aipheysgemstone.name: Aiphey's Gemstone

alcohol.details: Drink a bottle of alcohol, and have the potential to gain a slight luck boost that will grant you better luck in stealing from others. However, you become more susceptible to being stolen from! There is also a 10% chance you will die from alcohol poisoning.
alcohol.flavor: This is the cheap stuff. Not quite Bud Lite, but similar.
alcohol.name: Alcohol

aliensample.flavor: This is payback for the samples they've taken from us!
aliensample.name: Alien Sample

ammo.details: While this item is active, you cannot find "nothing" while hunting. Found from the professional hunter job.
ammo.flavor: Does this ammo even fit the hunting rifle?
ammo.name: Ammo

amulet.details: While this item is active, you cannot find "nothing" while digging. Found from the grave digger job.
amulet.flavor: Soil your hands, but never your reputation, as you unearth the secrets hidden beneath the surface with this totally NOT stolen amulet.
amulet.name: Stolen Amulet

ant.flavor: The movie "Antz" is in fact one of the movies of all time.
ant.name: Ant

antirobpack.details: Opening this will give you some basic rob deterrence items.
antirobpack.flavor: Try not to get robbed. Unless you're into that, then do what you want.
antirobpack.name: Anti-Rob Pack

aplus.flavor: The only time I earned this is when I edited it on my professor's pc.
aplus.name: A Plus

apple.details: Eating this once a day makes it so you do not lose any inventory or active items if you die. The lifesaver takes priority over this effect. (Lasts 24 hours)
apple.flavor: Sweet apples are better than tart, no one will change my mind.
apple.name: Apple

apron.details: Using this item will turn your embeds pink.
apron.flavor: A handmade pink apron, finely crafted for Michelin Star chefs, is mainly found in the kitchen.
apron.name: Apron

armpithair.details: Using this lets you do something gross.
armpithair.name: Armpit Hair

australiabox.flavor: How many spiders can you count in this box? I count zero. Oh that's because it's behind you.
australiabox.name: Australia Adventure Box

baby.flavor: This is a virtual baby. Not a real baby. Needed to clear that up for some people.
baby.name: Baby

badoszcard.flavor: A real king in the sleeve.
badoszcard.name: Badosz's Card

bait.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
bait.flavor: All my homies (fish) love biting this (fake) food.
bait.name: Legacy Fishing Bait

baitbox.details: This box contains any bait that are available year-round.
baitbox.flavor: This box contains baits, similar to how I was baited into giving a scammer my credit card info.
baitbox.name: Bait Box

banhammer.details: Found from the discord mod job.
banhammer.flavor: Mods swing this hard and fast, which also happens to be the title of my next se-
banhammer.name: Ban Hammer

banknote.details: You can use this item to expand your max bank space.
banknote.flavor: Imagine if banks actually had a max amount. Wait, some do? Thanks Obama.
banknote.name: Bank Note

bathwater.details: Using this gives you watery blue embed colors, and GREATLY increases the chance of diamonds spawning on your farm for the next 3 days. (Because pepe blessed you with their watery stink)
bathwater.flavor: The flavor of pepe's bathwater will remain a mystery to everyone except DMC moderators.
bathwater.name: Pepe's Bathwater

beaker.flavor: Please do not drink this, I think it came from Craig's room.
beaker.name: Beaker of Sus Fluid

beanmp3.details: Using this posts an audio file of B E A N S.
beanmp3.flavor: Beans beans, the magical fruit. The more you eat, the more your voice turns into an mp3 file.
beanmp3.name: Bean Mp3 Player

beanseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
beanseeds.flavor: If beans make you fart, does the thing that makes beans make you fart too? Someone test this!
beanseeds.name: Bean Seeds

beggarsbowl.details: When used, coins from begging are doubled while the item is still active. (After your coin multiplier!)
beggarsbowl.flavor: Despite being used to beg, I'd put my keys here after a long day at work. The bowl looks cozy.
beggarsbowl.name: Beggars Bowl

berriesandcream.details: Use this item to send it to someone who loves berries and cream!
berriesandcream.flavor: I'm a little lad who loves... CoD and Doritos!
berriesandcream.name: Berries and Cream

bigbrain.flavor: A brain so massive that it simply CANNOT be a discord user. Therefore, we sellin this shit for profit.
bigbrain.name: Big Brain

binary.flavor: I dare you to translate this binary into text.
binary.name: Binary

birthdaycake.details: Only obtainable during Dank Memer's birthday (January 17th). This item cannot be traded or transferred to other players.
birthdaycake.flavor: Anything but ice-cream "cake", unless that's the lie.
birthdaycake.name: Birthday Cake

blackhole.details: Having any amount of this item in your inventory gives you a chance to have it suck up an item you find while using the bot. This happening enters you into a chance of winning a daily black hole lottery containing part of all the items sucked up in a day!
blackhole.flavor: I don't think this is safe to keep around?
blackhole.name: Black Hole

blob.details: Using this does not consume it, but does nothing of value.
blob.flavor: The blob will rise again, look to the sky and ask for forgiveness.
blob.name: Blob

blueplasticbits.flavor: Blue is a fan favorite, I especially like Bluey.
blueplasticbits.name: Blue Plastic Bits

bluesplane.flavor: This top-of-the-line aircraft carries only the most prestigious of passengers.
bluesplane.name: Blue's Plane

boar.flavor: Some people think this item can be a bit boaring.
boar.name: Boar

boomerang.flavor: Like a fly to shit, it always comes back.
boomerang.name: Boomerang

boxbox.flavor: Box in a box in a box in a box in a box in a box in a box.
boxbox.name: Box Box

boxedchocolates.details: Using this item will raise your marriage level.
boxedchocolates.flavor: Life is like a chocolate of boxes. Wait, that's not right.
boxedchocolates.name: Boxed Chocolates

brazilbox.flavor: You cannot contain Brazil in a box. We've tried.
brazilbox.name: Brazil Adventure Box

bread.details: Using this will do nothing of value.
bread.flavor: Idk how fresh this bread can be when it sits in sweaty Dank Memer player inventories all day.
bread.name: Fresh Bread

broccoli.flavor: Little trees go in my mouf.
broccoli.name: Broccoli

broccoliseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
broccoliseeds.flavor: Place them somewhere dark and damp and watch them grow to be edible. You just ate damp and old seeds.
broccoliseeds.name: Broccoli Seeds

broom.details: Own this item to be able to use the broom in the Tidy command. Using a broom gives you 2x the xp you'd normally gain while tidying. There is a small chance to break your broom.
broom.flavor: No witches in sight, your broom is safe from a life of indentured riding.
broom.name: Broom

bundlebox.details: You have (basically) a 50-50 chance for bread or an empowered fart bottle (with a tiny chance at a gem box!)
bundlebox.flavor: Some evil developer came up with this idea.
bundlebox.name: Bundle Box

butterfly.flavor: A beautiful butterfly in the sky, but I think I can fly twice as high. This item was made for a previous team member, Amathine
butterfly.name: Rare Butterfly

cactus.flavor: Everyone knows someone who reminds them of what this cactus does, a bit of a prick.
cactus.name: Cactus

caipirinha.details: Using this item will affect your next rob (no timer) and has a 35% chance to guarantee you steal the max possible value with no dropped coins if it is successful. However, it also has a 65% chance of failing, and you will give the victim a random item from your inventory or ALL of your coins if you have no items. We'll never know which until you rob.
caipirinha.flavor: Don’t worry about what this drink is made of. Worry about proving what you’re made of by drinking it.
caipirinha.name: Caipirinha

camera.details: This item helps you with the amount of viewers watching your streams. Lasts for 3 days.
camera.flavor: Can be used to stream both on Twitch AND onlyfans!
camera.name: Camera

candy.details: Using this item will give a small amount of coins.
candy.flavor: It is not saltwater taffy. Unless...
candy.name: Candy

candycane.details: Using this item gives nothing of value.
candycane.flavor: I get that it is candy, but how is it a cane? It is way too small to use to walk.
candycane.name: Candy Cane

candycorn.details: Using this item will give you a level instantly. You can use more than one at once to level in bulk!
candycorn.flavor: I'm starting to think whoever developed this bot just really likes corn.
candycorn.name: Candy Corn

canetoad.flavor: Go watch "Cane Toads An Unnatural History 1988" on Youtube rn.
canetoad.name: Cane Toad

carrot.flavor: Bottom. Top was taken by the comedian.
carrot.name: Carrot

carrotseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
carrotseeds.flavor: Plant these to grow cucumbers that are orange and help you see in the dark.
carrotseeds.name: Carrot Seeds

cash.details: Use this item to turn it into banknotes or pizzas. Found from the politician job.
cash.flavor: Wait so you gave me a stack of cash and I have to trade it for only 2 things? This sounds more like a coupon.
cash.name: Stack of Cash

chadsweights.flavor: He doesn't need these anymore, he's got a permanant gains buff.
chadsweights.name: Chad's Weights

cheese.details: For every bag of shredded cheese consumed, you get a stacking XP multiplier, capping at **1.5x** (**50** bags of cheese consumed). There is also a chance it will fail and you will lose a lot of experience points.
cheese.flavor: Standing at the kitchen door, staring at the fridge. It calls my name.
cheese.name: Shredded Cheese

chetsusb.flavor: Some say the secret to Chet's success is in this USB. Others say it's just a bunch of cat videos because he's secretly broke.
chetsusb.name: Chet's USB

chillpill.details: Using this item does nothing of value.
chillpill.flavor: Chill Phil, take a big ol chill pill.
chillpill.name: Chill Pill

chocolatecake.details: You can use this item to obtain a pepe skin over with our friends at bake.gg!
chocolatecake.flavor: Everyone loves chocolate cake. EVERYONE. No exceptions. Don't argue with me.
chocolatecake.name: Chocolate Cake

christmasgift.details: Opening this will give you some Christmas themed items to celebrate!
christmasgift.flavor: Merry Christmas from the Dank Memer team!
christmasgift.name: Christmas Gift

christmastree.flavor: This tree is missing an ornament. Must have fallen and broke back in 2005.
christmastree.name: Christmas Tree

coinbomb.details: Using this item starts a coinbomb giveaway where users can join and earn a few thousand coins.
coinbomb.flavor: This is not safe to take on planes. Not because it's a weapon, but because the pilots would leave the cockpit to partake.
coinbomb.name: Coin Bomb

coinnuke.details: Use this in the same way you'd use a coin bomb, it spreads coins in chat. But a LOT of them! (100m-250m range) There is a chance when joining this that you can die. It's uh, a nuke after all.
coinnuke.flavor: Sometimes a coin BOMB isn't enough. Duke would be proud.
coinnuke.name: Coin Nuke

coinvoucher.details: Using this item will turn it into 10 million coins.
coinvoucher.flavor: Sometimes you need an item to turn into coins. This is that item, duh.
coinvoucher.name: Coin Voucher

collar.details: Use on a prestiged pet so it can begin learning skills. Found from the veterinarian job.
collar.flavor: The collar of the 42nd cat girl I've lost this year.
collar.name: Pet Collar

compass.details: While this item is active, you have a small chance to double coins and item rewards from adventure interactions. Found from the adventurer job.
compass.flavor: Navigate through life's twists and turns with confidence, and you'll never feel lost or un-compass-ionate about your choices.
compass.name: Adventure Compass

cookedeggs.flavor: Did you know pepe lays eggs? Us neither, it freaked us out and I'm not sure where to go from here.
cookedeggs.name: Cooked Eggs

cookie.details: Using this will do nothing of value.
cookie.flavor: They said don't eat the dough raw, but that will NOT stop me.
cookie.name: Cookie

corncob.flavor: Corny jokes are the life blood of this bot.
corncob.name: Corncob

corndog.flavor: Ok so hear me out man, it's pork or beef wrapped in a cornbread breading. I call it... the CORN DOG! Wait why are dogs involved?
corndog.name: Corndog

cornknife.flavor: Greg doesn't go anywhere without his corn and his knife.
cornknife.name: Corn Knife

cornseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
cornseeds.flavor: Corn cobs? Rare? Let's make an entire feature around growing more.
cornseeds.name: Corn Seeds

coupon.details: You will have the option to use this at a coin shop checkout. You can get 5% off any coin purchase from the shop. Found from the dank memer shopkeeper job.
coupon.flavor: This coupon expired last month, which is why it no longer applies to drop item sales.
coupon.name: Shop Coupon

cowboyboots.details: When you use this item you gain an extra 2.0x XP multi for 1 hour.
cowboyboots.flavor: Wear these as a SPUR of the moment fashion choice you coward!
cowboyboots.name: Cowboy Boots

cowboyhat.details: Using this gives you cowboy themed embed colors. (Brown, leather colored)
cowboyhat.flavor: Doug Dimmadome would be proud of this.
cowboyhat.name: Cowboy Hat

creditcard.details: You can use this item to "buy" someone or yourself 5 days of premium perks for Dank Memer. (Close to the $3 perk value, missing a few things)
creditcard.flavor: My mom will never know this is missing.
creditcard.name: Credit Card

cryptocoin.details: Use this to turn your embeds gold!
cryptocoin.flavor: I will not comment on the state of crypto. I will not comment on the state of crypto. I will not comment on the state of crypto.
cryptocoin.name: Crypto Scam Coin

cupidsbigtoe.details: Applies a multiplier of **69%** for **69 seconds**.
cupidsbigtoe.flavor: Cupid lost this in a bet. I took it fair and square, legally of course.
cupidsbigtoe.name: Cupid's Big Toe

cursedpepe.flavor: A pepe that not even a mother could love... But I sure do.
cursedpepe.name: Cursed Pepe

cutters.details: Owning this item makes you break padlocks when robbing.
cutters.flavor: I made this item to rob from normies without ever failing, now lots of people have it so I had to nerf it to just break a padlock. Lame devs, L.
cutters.name: Bolt Cutters

d100.flavor: This d100 is for display only. Trying to roll it would certainly break it every time. You can obtain this from winning a d100 random event!
d100.name: D100

daily.details: Using this item gives you a 10 minute 2.0x XP multi as well as some basic loot.
daily.flavor: A box FROM daily commands, not DAILY gained. Smh users.
daily.name: Daily Box

dank.flavor: Every time I open these the contents are wet. I hate Dank rewards.
dank.name: Dank Box

dankmemershdd.flavor: The developers dropped this in the water. Who wants free currency?
dankmemershdd.name: Dank Memer's Hard Drive

deer.flavor: Bambi deserved better than this, but man oh man is the jerky gonna be good.
deer.name: Deer

delta9.flavor: Not as fruitful as blue meth, but way less illegal (in some places). How does this yield so few usable bits? Weird game design.
delta9.name: Delta 9

delta9roll.details: For a random amount of time, your roll will give you a random luck boost (10-50%). There is a chance to face consequences, however.
delta9roll.flavor: Light a roll and chill until the buzz wears off.
delta9roll.name: Delta 9 Roll

delta9seeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
delta9seeds.flavor: Don't STRAIN too hard to farm this.
delta9seeds.name: Delta 9 Seeds

developerbox.flavor: Each developer item earned gives a little more of their soul away. Like in Harry Potter!
developerbox.name: Developer Box

devilshorn.details: Consuming this horny object while married gives you a month long effect that increases the chance (slightly) of having babies with your partner (in game of course, don't be a freak).
devilshorn.flavor: If there's one thing we know for sure, it's that some portion of the population will find the devil sexy.
devilshorn.name: Devil's Horn

diamond.flavor: Would you rather shine bright like a diamond, or spend 3 of them on a pickaxe. The choice is simple to me.
diamond.name: Diamond

diaper.details: Throw this used diaper at someone to prevent them from joining or starting a heist for 12 hours. Found from the house wife job.
diaper.flavor: This is used, but seems like too much for a child. Who wore this?
diaper.name: Used Diaper

diggingtrophy.details: Having one of these in your inventory will allow you to use the dig command without a shovel.
diggingtrophy.name: Digging Trophy

dragon.details: You can use this item to get a unique pet
dragon.flavor: In DnD 5e, an adult red dragon is chaotic evil and has a challenge rating of 17. You're telling me someone shot this one with a rifle?
dragon.name: Dragon

duck.flavor: Ducks lay eggs very similarly edible to chicken eggs. One of my favorite differences are that they can be blue depending on the breed of duck.
duck.name: Duck

ducttape.details: This item can be used to craft things with the craft command.
ducttape.flavor: It is not suspicious to buy this from the store UNLESS you buy it in bulk and wear a dark hoodie.
ducttape.name: Duct Tape

echidna.flavor: What that tongue do? No seriously, look up an echidna tongue, wtf does that do.
echidna.name: Echidna

ectoplasm.flavor: Ew, ghost gunk. Disgusting. Funky wunky ghosty gunky.
ectoplasm.name: Ectoplasm

electrifyingzing.details: While active, this will double your streaming profits for 24 hours.
electrifyingzing.flavor: Ignite your taste buds with the "Electrifying Zing" — a culinary sensation that harnesses the electrifying essence of the electric eel, delivering a harmonious fusion of flavors that will leave you buzzing with culinary delight.
electrifyingzing.name: Electrifying Zing

elfontheshelf.details: Using this elf places it on your farm for the next 7 days. During that time, you'll get notifications when your crops are ready to harvest!
elfontheshelf.flavor: Chippy is angry and chippy is going to make that YOUR problem.
elfontheshelf.name: Elf On The Shelf

embalmingfluid.details: When you drink this, it will kill you. Found from the mortician job.
embalmingfluid.flavor: The dead drink it, but drinking it also results in death.
embalmingfluid.name: Embalming Fluid

empoweredfartbottle.details: Use this item to throw at a user to prevent them from running commands for a while, you cannot fail.
empoweredfartbottle.flavor: This is like a fart bottle but like, without the downsides. Crazy item design right?
empoweredfartbottle.name: Empowered Fart Bottle

enchantedbad.flavor: It's a Badosz card, but enchanted. If only the enchantment DID something!
enchantedbad.name: Enchanted Badosz's Card

enchantedclover.details: Using this clover gives you a full day's boost of 150% additional luck, 1000% coin multiplier, 3x XP multiplier, as well as 500,000,000 coins. Consumed on use.
enchantedclover.flavor: This clover seems un-human. No way a simple dog pissing caused it to be this OP. Maybe a leprechaun pissed on it?
enchantedclover.name: Enchanted Clover

energydrink.details: Drinking this decreases the time between your work shifts for 6 hours. Found from the pro gamer job.
energydrink.flavor: Guess the brand that inspired this art. Nope, wrong. It was bud lite.
energydrink.name: Energy Drink

exclusivegembox.details: This box contains some of the offerings available for purchase for gems only!
exclusivegembox.flavor: Gold Gold Gold Gold Gold Titan Holo Titan Holo
exclusivegembox.name: Exclusive Gems Box

exoticfish.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
exoticfish.flavor: If this was Minecraft, this fish would be used to feed a pet axolotl
exoticfish.name: Legacy Exotic Fish

eye.flavor: The only one who could see the dark globule in the distance, and now watches over the rest.
eye.name: Odd Eye

fakeid.details: Using this item hides you from the robbers wishlist.
fakeid.flavor: McLovin would be proud of the quality of this expensive and very real ID.
fakeid.name: Fake ID

farmgoods.flavor: Man oh man, I sure love me some local farm goods!
farmgoods.name: Farm Processed Goods

fartinabottle.details: Using this on someone prevents them from running commands for a short while. It has the chance to backfire and hit you instead.
fartinabottle.flavor: "You're either a smart fella or a fart smella." -TheLazyTownie
fartinabottle.name: Fart In A Bottle

fertilizerbag.details: This tool can be used with the farm command to fertilize crops and shorten the time needed for plants to grow. Crops can be fertilized multiple times.
fertilizerbag.flavor: "Fertilize me", now without Ammonium nitrate because that's not good
fertilizerbag.name: Fertilizer Bag

fiercefangfare.details: On your next successful rob attempt, having this active will prevent you from dropping any coins on the ground.
fiercefangfare.flavor: Embrace the wild side of your palate with "Fierce Fang Fare" — a tantalizing culinary creation that unleashes the bold flavors of the ferocious piranha, leaving you craving for more.
fiercefangfare.name: Fierce Fang Fare

figureswatch.flavor: The time on this watch seems all out of whack. What's up with this guy?
figureswatch.name: Figure's Watch

fish.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
fish.flavor: This fish is pretty common, unlike my ability to come up with good flavor text.
fish.name: Legacy Common Fish

fishingpole.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
fishingpole.flavor: It's no Bassmaster 2000 but it should do the job.
fishingpole.name: Legacy Fishing Pole

fishingtrophy.flavor: Once upon a time, to get this trophy you had to shove hundreds of fish into a crafting bench.
fishingtrophy.name: Fishing Trophy

fishseasonbox.details: Opening this box will give you a season pass cosmetic (free or paid track) from any previous season that you missed. If you unlocked everything, this will give you nothing of value.
fishseasonbox.flavor: AHHHHHHHHHHH. Oh wait it's not a battle pass, it's a season pass. Nevermind.
fishseasonbox.name: Season Box

fishtacklebox.details: Opening this box will give you some kind of fishing related gear.
fishtacklebox.flavor: Wow I love fishing. Please don't tackle me.
fishtacklebox.name: Fish Tackle Box

fool.flavor: An item for fools. NO I meant April fools...
fool.name: Fool's Notif

fossil.details: You can use this item to start a quest for a unique pet.
fossil.flavor: How did my grandmother get into this bot as an item?
fossil.name: Fossil

garbage.flavor: What has 6 wheels and flies? A garbage truck!
garbage.name: Garbage

giantcentipede.flavor: Not all things creepy, are crawly. Not all things crawly, are creepy. This little shit is creepy crawly.
giantcentipede.name: Giant Centipede

gift.flavor: Why do you have your friend's gift still, give it to them already.
gift.name: Friend's Gift

giftbox.flavor: The lootbox that cannot be opened. The cursed lootbox if you will.
giftbox.name: Gift Box

gildedclover.details: Using this clover gives you a quick 15 minute boost of 100% additional luck, and 500% coin multiplier, as well as 5,000,000 coins. Consumed on use.
gildedclover.flavor: I don't know how this clover turned gold. Does my dog piss liquid gold? I gotta make money off this, it's just TOO good!
gildedclover.name: Gilded Clover

god.flavor: This box is the lifeblood of my wallet.
god.name: God Box

goldencoins.details: This item is only acquired by staff for Dank Memer's server. It is not in any way able to be transferred to or from people, so if someone has it that means they helped manage giveaways or moderate for some time.
goldencoins.flavor: The golden coins of Melmsie's appreciation, not worth much but at least normies don't get them.
goldencoins.name: Golden Coins

goldencorndog.flavor: Why is this golden. It does not look edible at all.
goldencorndog.name: Golden Corndog

goldennugget.flavor: It looks like a golden doo doo, it must be worth a lot!
goldennugget.name: Golden Nugget

goldenplasticbits.flavor: The icon, the legend, the... oh the market price is dropping again
goldenplasticbits.name: Golden Plastic Bits

grass.flavor: This item is a paradox. If someone owns it they probably do not touch grass, yet they are currently touching grass.
grass.name: Grass

gravestone.flavor: Having this means you died. Unless you bought it from someone else on the market. Imagine buying someone else's gravestone. New black market listing unlocked!
gravestone.name: Gravestone

greenscreen.details: This item increases your revenue from streaming. Lasts for 3 days.
greenscreen.flavor: Hide the mess behind you so people don't know you're in shambles.
greenscreen.name: Green Screen

grindpack.details: Opening this will give you some basic grind assisting items.
grindpack.flavor: Grinding can be unhealthy, take breaks and touch grass.
grindpack.name: Grind Pack

grubpail.details: While active, coins earned from digging are quadrupled. Lasts for 1 hour.
grubpail.flavor: A pail of grubs that will make you pale and flub.
grubpail.name: Grub Pail

hardhat.details: Using this gives you construction colored embeds.
hardhat.flavor: Worn by the hard working gremlins behind the scenes at Dank Memer HQ while running in circles putting out fires.
hardhat.name: Hardhat

hauntedbox.flavor: This box is packed with 1000 souls of previous dank players. Once they quit, they died and we shoved them in this box. I think that's the right order of events?
hauntedbox.name: Haunted Box

headphones.details: This item increases your max idle time.
headphones.flavor: Open back is the best quality you'll find in headphones.
headphones.name: Headphones

hoe.details: This tool can be used with the farm command to till dirt before planting or to clean up after a harvest.
hoe.flavor: Ain't nobody getting between me and my bros, bros before uh... nevermind.
hoe.name: Hoe

holybadoszbread.flavor: This bread might be holy, but it smells TERRIBLE and probably should not be touched with a ten foot pole. This must be 10,000 years old.
holybadoszbread.name: Holy Badosz's Bread

holywater.flavor: This water is (metaphorically) used to cleanse the eyes of anyone who looked at Badosz.
holywater.name: Holy Water

hoodie.details: Using this item gives you black embed colors.
hoodie.flavor: Darkus wanted a hoodie item for winning a competition. AS REQUESTED, a designer hoodie!
hoodie.name: Designer Hoodie

horseshoe.details: Activating this gives you increased chance at higher tier drops in grind commands. Anywhere you see a horseshoe while this is active, that command is being affected.
horseshoe.flavor: The horse was named lucky, but are we sure it was... lucky?
horseshoe.name: Lucky Horseshoe

hotdog.flavor: Personally I prefer these but the chili dogs are the only ones on doordash so idk.
hotdog.name: Sanic Hot Dog

huntingrifle.details: This item is required to access the hunt command.
huntingrifle.flavor: Bambi is VERY upset with you. Put it down!
huntingrifle.name: Hunting Rifle

huntingtrophy.details: Having one of these in your inventory will allow you to use the hunt command without a hunting rifle.
huntingtrophy.flavor: It's a 27 point buck, just believe me and do NOT try and count it.
huntingtrophy.name: Hunting Trophy

inflateddelicacy.details: Doubles the sale value of any creatures for fish tokens, for 15 minutes.
inflateddelicacy.flavor: Indulge in the exquisite "Inflated Delicacy" — a culinary masterpiece that artfully combines the unique textures and flavors of the pufferfish, creating a truly unforgettable dining experience.
inflateddelicacy.name: Inflated Delicacy

inspacebox.flavor: Do not move, I think I hear a black hole in that box.
inspacebox.name: Space Adventure Box

jacky.details: Using this item will turn embed colors into spooky fall colors.
jacky.flavor: The name is how it is because I did not want people calling it jack. People did it anyway.
jacky.name: Jacky o' Lanty

jarofsingularity.flavor: Wait, HOW did they get this in a jar?
jarofsingularity.name: Jar Of Singularity

jellyfish.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
jellyfish.flavor: Lucky for you this was not a Box jellyfish, look it up.
jellyfish.name: Legacy Jelly Fish

jokebook.details: When consumed, you cannot post a dead meme for 3 hours as long as this item is active.
jokebook.flavor: Imagine needing to read a book to be funny. Nice job, unfunny nerd.
jokebook.name: Joke Book

junk.flavor: What do raccoons eat? Junk food!
junk.name: Junk

kablessunglasses.details: Using this item on someone reminds them that no one asked.
kablessunglasses.flavor: A chad item for virgin staff member.
kablessunglasses.name: Kable's Sunglasses

kamssticks.details: You cannot accidentally get too greedy while streaming for 6 hours.
kamssticks.name: Kam's Sticks

karen.flavor: She wants to speak to your manager.
karen.name: Literally Karen

keyboard.details: This item is required to access the stream command.
keyboard.flavor: Why are they called keys? Do they unlock the ability to type?
keyboard.name: Keyboard

kraken.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
kraken.flavor: This thing is a pain to have around, it's always kraken jokes.
kraken.name: Legacy Kraken

ladybug.flavor: Fun fact, not all Lady Bugs are lady bugs. Another fun fact is that these bugs smell like shit.
ladybug.name: Ladybug

landmine.details: Once active, if someone tries to steal from you, there's a 50% chance they will die from blowing up. Lasts 24 hours.
landmine.flavor: Who would have thought a game with pets would also involve landmines.
landmine.name: Landmine

laptop.flavor: Imagine using a laptop instead of a cellphone in 2027, wait it's not 2027 yet carry on.
laptop.name: Laptop

lasso.flavor: Yeeeeeehaw, I done wrangled me a critter with this!
lasso.name: Lasso

lawdegree.flavor: I got my law degree the same way Mike Ross got his. Walking into the wrong office. Now I want to sell it.
lawdegree.name: Law Degree

legendaryfish.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
legendaryfish.flavor: This fish is only half as legendary as the sailors it has brought to the bottom of the sea.
legendaryfish.name: Legacy Legendary Fish

letter.details: Using this item gives you some messages from the people who won an item competition years ago.
letter.flavor: What's in the letter? Open it up to find out!
letter.name: The Letter

lifesaver.details: When you die with one of these in your inventory, you are saved from death.
lifesaver.flavor: The heart is crunchy and has no flavor. Better save it for later.
lifesaver.name: Life Saver

likebutton.flavor: SMASH THAT LIKE BUTTON, RING THE BELL
likebutton.name: Like Button

lotterywinner.details: Owning this gives you a 5% chance at two rewards after winning a random event. Lucky you!
lotterywinner.flavor: Is it even that lucky?? You probably paid 5b to win, p2w p2w p2w- oh that's a lottery.
lotterywinner.name: Winning Lottery Ticket

lotusflower.flavor: The lotus flower does not know where it's not, because it does not know where it isn't.
lotusflower.name: Lotus Flower

lotusseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
lotusseeds.flavor: Lotus flowers do not taste like watermelon.
lotusseeds.name: Lotus Seeds

luckyclover.details: Using this clover gives you a quick 10 minute boost of 50% additional luck.
luckyclover.flavor: A lucky lil guy found in the yard. Don't eat it, my dog likes to pee there.
luckyclover.name: Lucky Clover

margauxsdoll.flavor: Margaux has a blond doll. It has a button that plays a voice singing "I'm just Kevin."
margauxsdoll.name: Margaux's Doll

megaphone.flavor: The voice of the people echo through this. This item was made for a previous team member, Alexa.
megaphone.name: The Megaphone

melmsiebanana.details: Using this banana consumes it, and sends Melmsie a DM letting them know you ate their banana. Weird flex but ok.
melmsiebanana.flavor: I swear to god I once ate like 8 of these in one sitting.
melmsiebanana.name: Melmsie's Banana

melmsiebeard.flavor: I am livid that someone shaved this off my face.
melmsiebeard.name: Melmsie's Beard

membershipbox.flavor: Pay to win? No way baby this is pay to ENJOY (by winning).
membershipbox.name: Membership Box

membershippack.details: Opening this will give you some somewhat rarer items to assist in your gameplay.
membershippack.flavor: Thanks for supporting us! Now shut up and take my items.
membershippack.name: Membership Pack

meme.flavor: You're telling me there is NO memes in this box? Only items and coins? False advertisement???
meme.name: Meme Box

memepills.flavor: Sell these bad boys. Maybe we should dye them blue too.
memepills.name: Meme Pills

menorah.flavor: "Missing two candles! Melmsie it is wrong it's missing two candles!" It's on PURPOSE, our artist made the executive decision to cut off two candles to be able to add more detail to the rest of it.
menorah.name: Menorah

meridianscroc.flavor: A prized possession of sea, Meridian loves this.
meridianscroc.name: Meridian's Croc

messageinabottle.details: This has no usage but to be sold. For now...
messageinabottle.flavor: A message from a stranger contained in an old bottle. Found in saltwater.
messageinabottle.name: Message In a Bottle

metalpipe.details: Sends a metal pipe in chat. Why? Because it's a metal pipe. What else do you want from me? (also this consumes the pipe)
metalpipe.name: Metal Pipe

meteorite.details: Using this item starts a secret quest for a green cutie!
meteorite.flavor: Thank god this didn't hit the Earth!
meteorite.name: Meteorite

microphone.details: This item helps keep your stream online for longer by lowering the chance for it to randomly end while interacting. Lasts for 3 days.
microphone.flavor: Honestly the most important aspect of a streamer's toolkit.
microphone.name: Microphone

mistletoe.details: Use this mistletoe on someone to give their profile picture a big ol' kiss. Consumed on use, so kiss carefully!
mistletoe.name: Mistletoe

moleman.flavor: I suggest seeing your dermatologist about this mole as I'm not sure liquid nitrogen works on things with claws.
moleman.name: Mole Man

mouse.details: This item is required to access the stream command.
mouse.flavor: Why is it called a mouse?
mouse.name: Mouse

multiplasticbits.flavor: In a world full of color, things like this item become possible with only imagination.
multiplasticbits.name: Multi Colored Plastic Bits

newplayerpack.details: Opening this will give you some basic items.
newplayerpack.flavor: A pack to get you on your feet in the bot as a new player.
newplayerpack.name: New Player Pack

normie.flavor: Little box packs a little punch. Not a big punch, it's a normie boxbox.
normie.name: Normie Box

note.flavor: A single note is enough to change the world. Of course, only if that note is a written note to a world power telling them "I bet you can't nuke that other world power". Has nothing to do with music.
note.name: Musical Note

oldbox.flavor: Is the box old or the items inside? Ok well that is a bit misleading isn't it.
oldbox.name: Old Box

oldshell.flavor: This might have been pretty... once upon a time. Found in saltwater.
oldshell.name: Old Shell

omegabox.details: This box contains omega cosmetics and fish gear from omega 30 and under. You also get a 50% luck multi for 7 days. The fish bait has a tiny chance because it is a fallback for once all the cosmetics have been knocked out, just to prevent getting nothing.
omegabox.flavor: Omega box tastes like litter boxes, not foxes.
omegabox.name: Omega Box

orangeplasticbits.flavor: The only thing that rhymes with orange is gullible
orangeplasticbits.name: Orange Plastic Bits

ornament.flavor: These make a satisfying sound when they fall of the tree in 2005 and make everyone in the house wake up and think a gun went off. Trust me.
ornament.name: Ornament

outwestbox.flavor: I bet the cactus is thriving in there.
outwestbox.name: Out West Adventure Box

padlock.details: Use this padlock to lock your wallet from robbers. It is a one time use item. It can be broken when someone tries to steal from you as well.
padlock.flavor: The lock picking lawyer would make quick work of this I'm ngl to you.
padlock.name: Padlock

paw.flavor: A squishy paw that can relieve stress and make you smile. SQUISH! SQUISH! SQUISH! (Yeng Gang rise up). This item was made for a previous team member, Yeng.
paw.name: Squishy Paw

pepe.flavor: Ironically enough, the rare pepe is not that rare.
pepe.name: Rare Pepe

pepebox.flavor: Pepe certainly did NOT hold me at gunpoint to make a pepe themed box. Who got that idea?
pepebox.name: Pepe Box

pepecoin.flavor: Can you even believe that this used to be the most expensive item? Now it's a gift you'd give your cousin as a hand me down.
pepecoin.name: Pepe Coin

pepecrown.flavor: Some say pepe personally gifted this crown to those who own it. That would be absurd though.
pepecrown.name: Pepe Crown

pepejug.details: Using this gives you neon pepe embed colors for 30 days.
pepejug.flavor: Chug this delicious jug made of pepes blended to perfection. (Kidding of course, that's gross. Right?)
pepejug.name: Pepe Jug

pepemedal.flavor: This medal used to be rare, now it's just a secondhand bargain bin item for the rich players.
pepemedal.name: Pepe Medal

pepemite.flavor: Salty, kind of bitter, and loved by Australians. If you're reading this, tell your mother I said g'day!
pepemite.name: Pepemite

peperibbon.flavor: A ribbon? You think I want a RIBBON? Oh it's pepe themed? Count me in.
peperibbon.name: Pepe Ribbon

pepering.flavor: Go go gadget deploy pepe ring! Oh it's just a Collectible.
pepering.name: Pepe Ring

pepestatue.flavor: A statue immortalizing pepe, as all statues should.
pepestatue.name: Pepe Statue

pepesus.flavor: Pepe... why are you looking so SUS step bro
pepesus.name: Pepe Sus

pepetoilet.flavor: I don't care what the children say, we're never adding ski- oh fuck, we added it.
pepetoilet.name: Pepe Toilet

pepetrophy.flavor: A trophy that is worth its weight in coins. Sadly the weight is much lower than the purchase price.
pepetrophy.name: Pepe Trophy

petfeces.flavor: They look like chocolate lincoln logs. I must resist a little snacky.
petfeces.name: Pet Feces

petfeeder.details: Using this item will allow one of your pets to instantly learn the skill they are studying.
petfeeder.flavor: I wish I had a pet feeder that would dispense treats into my mouth as a human.
petfeeder.name: Pet Feeder

petfood.details: This item can be used to feed your pets. If you have one in your inventory, feeding with the /pets care command will take this item instead of coins. Using this fills the entire hunger bar and gives much more XP.
petfood.flavor: Beggin strips taste like actual bacon and I will eat them regularly.
petfood.name: Pet Food

petmedicine.details: Using this item will cure a pet of sickness.
petmedicine.flavor: Not for humans. But have you ever tried it? Tastes like bacon.
petmedicine.name: Pet Medicine

phone.details: Use your cell phone to text your friends via the notifications system, or ring the police in the case of a bankrobbery. Misusing it (such as dialing police when there's no trouble) may cost you money.
phone.flavor: Back in my day these flipped open and shut. Wait they brought that back?
phone.name: Cell Phone

pinkplasticbits.flavor: The classic item that new users will never know about
pinkplasticbits.name: Pink Plastic Bits (Deprecated)

pinkrubberducky.flavor: Made from a history full of pink... adult objects, this item was given originally as rewards for servers or users winning the "A Bit of Change" event!
pinkrubberducky.name: Pink Rubber Ducky

pinksludgemonster.flavor: Made from the billions of pink phallic objects smashed to bits. The bits got thrown away and turned into this vile creature.
pinksludgemonster.name: Pink Sludge Monster

piratehat.flavor: Did most pirates even wear hats? Show me the proof.
piratehat.name: Pirate Hat

pixeltrophy.details: Only obtainable from a developer as a special reward for creative or standout contributions to the community. Previously obtained by being a featured community member in our weekly Pixel Progression posts.
pixeltrophy.name: Pixel Trophy

pizza.details: Using this item will give you a 2.5x XP multi for 30 minutes.
pizza.flavor: You wanted pineapple chunks on this, we get it. Too bad.
pizza.name: Pizza Slice

plantclump.flavor: This is honestly kinda disgusting. Eat it. Found in freshwater.
plantclump.name: Soggy Plant Clump

plasticbag.flavor: Do you ever feel like one?
plasticbag.name: Plastic Bag

plasticbox.flavor: Imagine if this box existed when plastics were still...
plasticbox.name: Plastic Box

policebadge.details: Found from the police officer job.
policebadge.flavor: A shiny police badge, covered in the blood of their vic- nevermind.
policebadge.name: Police Badge

popper.details: Using this item will turn embed colors to silver or white.
popper.flavor: Only obtainable during New Years Eve (UTC), this item is an item to remember the past year while looking forward to the next.
popper.name: New Years Popper

postcard.details: Use this to send a friend a postcard! It will generate an image with your given text and DM it to them if their DMs are open to Dank Memer!
postcard.flavor: Pepe went to brazil, and all he got you was this postcard and a little drunk.
postcard.name: Postcard

poster.details: Provides a 5% work payout bonus, stacking up to 50%. Found from the manager job.
poster.flavor: This is the poster everyone stares at when getting yelled at for sitting on the job. Very motivational.
poster.name: Motivational Poster

potato.flavor: Straight from the motherland, home grown and well distributed. ☭
potato.name: Potato

potatoseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops. Try planting these in patterns with empty tilled and watered spaces nearby, and maybe you will discover a secret way to make new kinds of seeds appear and grow!
potatoseeds.flavor: Potato seeds are literally just... potatoes. What if we grew humans by planting humans. Wait, that is a zombie.
potatoseeds.name: Potato Seeds

prestigecoin.details: Using this item will give you 12 hours of 250% coin multiplier.
prestigecoin.flavor: A coin you get in exchange for losing most of your stuff. Seems fair.
prestigecoin.name: Prestige Coin

prestigepack.details: Opening this will give you some basic items.
prestigepack.flavor: Congrats on prestiging, here is the most basic list of items that will not matter because you no longer lose items when prestiging.
prestigepack.name: Prestige Pack

prismaticdelight.details: For 10 minutes, any bait you have equipped will not lose durability.
prismaticdelight.flavor: Indulge in the irresistible allure of "Prismatic Delight" — a mesmerizing fusion of flavors and colors, capturing the essence of the delectable rainbow bass.
prismaticdelight.name: Prismatic Delight

purpleplasticbits.flavor: Did you know purple is my favorite color?
purpleplasticbits.name: Purple Plastic Bits

puzzlekey.flavor: A key without a use. Is it intended to have no use? Will it ever? How puzzling...
puzzlekey.name: Puzzle Key

rabbit.flavor: A hip hop artist could mean two things. Wait, that makes no sense.
rabbit.name: Rabbit

rarefish.details: This item no longer serves any use after fishing 2.0 released.
rarefish.flavor: Some say this is the most rare fish in the sea! Until of course they catch an exotic or legendary fish.
rarefish.name: Legacy Rare Fish

reversal.flavor: Reversal cards were previously used to reverse a steal someone performed on you. Due to being SUPER buggy and causing multiple exploits, they are no longer functional, and never will be.
reversal.name: Reversal Card

revolver.details: Using this item starts a game of Russian Roulette in chat. 6 people are chosen from all the people who entered, there are 5 bullets in the chamber so only one will walk away with some cash.
revolver.flavor: Wait, what does Russian Roulette have to do with cowboys?
revolver.name: Old Cowboy Revolver

ring.details: Use this ring to propose a marriage to someone!
ring.flavor: Marriage in a MEME game? Disgusting.
ring.name: Engagement Ring

ringlight.details: This item lowers the minimum time between stream interactions. Lasts for 3 days.
ringlight.flavor: ElGato sells these, but you can make them yourself by taking an led panel and punching out the middle.
ringlight.name: Ring Light

robbersmask.details: Your name will not show up on steal or bankrob notifs sent to the victim for 12 hours after using. Found from the robber job.
robbersmask.flavor: Everyone knows when you put on a mask no one can tell who was under it, no matter what. It's the law.
robbersmask.name: Robbers Mask

rustymachine.details: Using this item gives you a chance to convert your excess seeds into something better. Warning, the machine often malfunctions, and good results are not guaranteed.
rustymachine.flavor: Pepe stole this rusty piece of junk from some abandoned farming museum and insists we let you use it. Don't ask us how it works.
rustymachine.name: Rusty Machine

saddle.details: Having this item in your inventory gives all your pets a small xp boost when walking them.
saddle.flavor: I got the horses in the back, horse tack is attached...
saddle.name: Pet Saddle

samuelsbook.flavor: This book is where Samuel learned how to parent. And I gotta say, he's a kickass dad.
samuelsbook.name: Samuel's Book

sand.details: Throw a box of sand in someone's eyes to prevent them from robbing anyone for 30 minutes. There is a small chance the sand will blow back in your own face and give you the negative effects.
sand.flavor: How many of you pee'd in the sandbox as children? Well this item takes from that exact sandbox.
sand.name: Box of Sand

santasbag.details: You can open this as if it were a lootbox with the use command. Obtained from working as Santa. Found from the santa claus job.
santasbag.flavor: I stole this from Santa. He didn't even fight back so I think it was legal.
santasbag.name: Santa's Bag

santashat.details: Using this item will give you Christmas themed colors.
santashat.flavor: I stole this right off his little jolly head.
santashat.name: Santa's Hat

scepter.details: This item can be used to change embed colors to "royal colors"
scepter.flavor: A royal scepter such as this is worth close to 50k gold carats, dang!
scepter.name: Royal Scepter

seaweed.flavor: Seaweed is not nearly as fun as land weed, and I stand by that.
seaweed.name: Seaweed

shootingstar.details: You can use this to transform your pet (given it's prestige 5+) to another type of pet with the same name and stats.
shootingstar.flavor: Make a wish upon this star and change who the pets are.
shootingstar.name: Shooting Star

shovel.details: This item is required to access the dig command.
shovel.flavor: Hitting things with a shovel usually fixes it.
shovel.name: Shovel

shrimptank.details: Doubles payouts for simple fishing for 6 hours.
shrimptank.flavor: The ultimate shrimp based aquascape, keep a healthy PH balance!
shrimptank.name: Advarsky's Shrimp Tank

skeletonkey.details: Use this to open a locked chest for a small reward!
skeletonkey.name: Skeleton Key

skunk.flavor: Skunks eat duck eggs. There is nothing else of importance to talk about with skunks, the duck leeches.
skunk.name: Skunk

sludgesbarrel.flavor: Toxic and stinky, but with something good inside.
sludgesbarrel.name: Barrel of Sludge

smolbrain.flavor: The brain of the average Discord user. We carefully captured this as a reward for you, and it's too fragile to do anything with except admire.
smolbrain.name: Smol Brain

snowball.details: Using this on a user will prevent them from doing negative actions to you for a few minutes.
snowball.flavor: Snowballs are not scary until you freeze them. This one is frozen.
snowball.name: Snowball

snowflake.flavor: Everyone is a unique snowflake, but not twins right?
snowflake.name: Snowflake

soggyboots.flavor: Soggy boots are friends, not food.
soggyboots.name: Soggy Boots

soundcard.details: This item helps your odds of getting other streaming items. Lasts for 3 days.
soundcard.flavor: Sound cards are kinda overrated irl.
soundcard.name: Sound Card

spider.flavor: Did you know that many people are scared of spiders? AAAAAAAHHHHH GET IT OFF MY SCREE-
spider.name: Spider

spinner.flavor: Once a stimulation tool, now a bad meme.
spinner.name: Fidget Spinner

spookymask.details: Formerly used to scare your pets, this mask is used to scare no one. For now?
spookymask.flavor: This mask is going to make someone scream, scream of fear or joy? Both!
spookymask.name: Spooky Mask

starfragment.flavor: Someone wished a little too hard and BROKE it!
starfragment.name: Star Fragment

stickbug.flavor: It is truly sad to think about how many stickbugs were so well hidden that they became campfire tinder.
stickbug.name: Stickbug

stocking.flavor: Some people call this a sock, I call it a HOLIDAY sock!
stocking.name: Holiday Stocking

stonkcoin.details: Using this item gives you +500% coin multiplier for 24 hours.
stonkcoin.flavor: Rotsevni wanted a stonk coin, so Rotsevni got a stonk coin. Winning our competitions pays off!
stonkcoin.name: Stonk Coin

stonkmachine.details: Use this machine to try and earn some coins from stonk investment. Warning, there is a 10% chance to lose 10% of your wallet from a bad investment! Found from the day trader job.
stonkmachine.flavor: This is a made up machine. It does not exist in real life. Do not search for this irl.
stonkmachine.name: Stonk Machine

streakfreeze.details: Using this item will turn it into an active item that lasts 7 days. Within those 7 days streaks, marriage, pets and work will be impossible to lose.
streakfreeze.flavor: Is it just me or is my streak freezing me out of the relationship?
streakfreeze.name: Streak Freeze

sugarskull.details: Using this item changes your embed colors to be Día de los Muertos themed.
sugarskull.flavor: Celebrate Día de los Muertos by using this, yum!
sugarskull.name: Sugar Skull

sunbearsd20.details: Using this rolls a d20. On a critical failure, it will break. Every other rolled number has something unique!
sunbearsd20.flavor: "Does fireball affect party members? Surely not... right?"
sunbearsd20.name: Sunbear's D20

sunkentreasure.flavor: How is it worth so much while so... sea-y?
sunkentreasure.name: Sunken Treasure

taco.details: Using this item will double your level up coin/item rewards for 30 minutes. Found from the fast food cook job.
taco.flavor: This is a beef taco, but we all know fish tacos are better.
taco.name: Crunchy Taco

taroroot.flavor: Have you ever bitten into a raw taro root? I have. You should not.
taroroot.name: Taro Root

taroseeds.flavor: The seeds don't taste as good as the root. Duh, learn about Taro idiot.
taroseeds.name: Taro Seeds

tentacledtemptation.details: While active, this will prevent you from dying in adventures for 3 hours. Instead of dying, the adventure will peacefully end.
tentacledtemptation.flavor: Embark on a tantalizing journey with the "Tentacled Temptation" — a delectable dish showcasing the succulent tenderness of giant squid, harmonizing with a symphony of complementary flavors that will captivate your taste buds.
tentacledtemptation.name: Tentacled Temptation

thrymsleash.flavor: Thrym is NOT a good doggo, but he does enjoy some leash time.
thrymsleash.name: Thrym's Leash

tidepod.flavor: Do not eat this. Do not ignore this warning because memes. Stop eating them. God damn it, stop it.
tidepod.name: Tidepod

tipjar.details: Use this item to get some random rewards every hour. Found from the twitch streamer job.
tipjar.flavor: Why do they slide the tip jar at me "accidentally" every time as if I wasn't going to tip.
tipjar.name: Tip Jar

titlebox.details: This box contains unique titles, and a few skin fragments in case you run out of titles.
titlebox.flavor: The title of this box is a Title Box but the title of my next masterpiece is: Mel x your mother
titlebox.name: Title Box

toiletpaper.flavor: If 2-ply is so good for my undercarriage, why not just double wrap it to make 4-ply?
toiletpaper.name: Toilet Paper

toolbox.details: This box contains any tools that are available year-round.
toolbox.flavor: This box contains tools, but it's also owned by tools. Do you own one?
toolbox.name: Tool Box

trash.flavor: I think I’m done buying trash bags... I always end up throwing them away anyways. Nvm the world is trash, I need them.
trash.name: Trash

treasuremap.details: Using this item spawns a mini game. If you win, you get some coins!
treasuremap.flavor: Follow carefully: To the left, take it back now ya'll, one hop this time!
treasuremap.name: Treasure Map

tree.flavor: This is literally a tree. What else did you expect.
tree.name: Literally a Tree

triviatrophy.details: These are earned from answering trivia questions correctly and cannot be transferred on the market or anywhere else.
triviatrophy.name: Trivia Trophy

tumbleweed.details: Using this consumes it and does nothing at all.
tumbleweed.flavor: These are a menace to society, look it up!
tumbleweed.name: Tumbleweed

universebox.details: Opening this box will instantly grant you 12 hours of 2xp, along with the random possible rewards.
universebox.flavor: The universe is only as big as you let it be.
universebox.name: Universe Box

urinal.flavor: Yes, that IS pee around the rim. How did you know?
urinal.name: School Urinal

vacationbox.flavor: Vacation in a box? Sooo it's a suitcase?
vacationbox.name: Vacation Adventure Box

vaccine.flavor: Momma told me if I get this here shot I can get that there sucker.
vaccine.name: Vaccine

vacuum.details: Own this item to be able to use the vacuum in the Tidy command. Using a vacuum gives you 2x the reward you'd normally gain while tidying. There is a small chance to break your vacuum.
vacuum.flavor: This thing SUCKS. All day all night, it just sucks.
vacuum.name: Vacuum

voodoodoll.details: Using this on someone will give them bad luck in grind commands for 30 minutes. Bad luck is like the opposite of the horseshoe effect but more potent.
voodoodoll.flavor: I keep feeling a stabbing feeling in heart. Is it a heart attack or a voodoo doll? Probably just the doll.
voodoodoll.name: Voodoo Doll

votepack.details: Opening this will give you some items you will probably use to help your grind.
votepack.flavor: I vote daily, where is my daily box!!!! Oh in the daily command, that makes sense.
votepack.name: Vote Pack

waterbucket.details: This tool can be used with the farm command to fill one tile completely with water, helping keep the surrounding tiles watered and cleaning the area after a harvest. When the water gets dirty it will no longer work and the space will have to dry before it can be used again.
waterbucket.flavor: It is possible the dEvElOpEr that created this item plays the hit game Minecraft
waterbucket.name: Water Bucket

wateringcan.details: This tool can be used with the farm command to water tilled tiles before planting.
wateringcan.flavor: Watering can? I sure can water with the watering can. Can I water the can first?
wateringcan.name: Watering Can

waterloggedlog.flavor: How you got this home... I'll never understand. Found in freshwater.
waterloggedlog.name: Waterlogged Log

watermelon.flavor: This is the kind with extra juice, so much that it's kinda surprising and you're not sure how all the juice fit in there in the first place. Then you try to drink the juice alone and it's just not that good. Idk.
watermelon.name: Watermelon

watermelonseeds.details: This item can be planted using the farm command to produce crops.
watermelonseeds.flavor: Someone told me that if I eat these watermelon will grow in my stomach. Can confirm!
watermelonseeds.name: Watermelon Seeds

weddinggift.flavor: Now you have to write thank you notes for all these gifts. Have fun!
weddinggift.name: Wedding Gift

weetsdonut.flavor: A strawberry topped donut with frosting that suspiciously keeps getting all over your face. You keep wiping but the frosting spreads.
weetsdonut.name: Weet's Donut

whiskey.details: Using this will give you a better chance to steal from people for 15 hours. Found from the bartender job.
whiskey.flavor: Whiskey and a little coke, daddy likey
whiskey.name: Bottle of Whiskey

wishlist.details: This item when used gives a list of users that aren't passive and do not have a fake ID on. Basically, anyone who is able to be robbed!
wishlist.flavor: Who would leave this laying around? It's such easy evidence against them...
wishlist.name: Robbers Wishlist

witchhat.details: Using this will consume it and give you witch themed embed colors.
witchhat.flavor: 🎵 Down, down, down the road - Down the witches' road - Follow me, my friend - To glory at the end 🎵
witchhat.name: Witch Hat

workbox.flavor: Wanna stay home from work and open lootboxes? WOAH TWO IN ONE?
workbox.name: Work Box

worm.flavor: Did you know that the [Alaskan Bull Worm](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SJ4u8I1RNWg) from SpongeBob Season 2 Episode 20 is in fact not based in reality?
worm.name: Worm

zaraspiratesword.flavor: Zara found this while fishing and uses it when people like Chet roll around.
zaraspiratesword.name: Zara's Pirate Sword

zombee.flavor: According to all known laws of the universe, there is no way a bee should be able to come back from the dead. The bee, of course, rises from the dead anyway because bees don't care what humans think is impossible.
zombee.name: ZomB's ZomBee

zombiehand.details: When used, the hand is destroyed. Once destroyed, finishing any adventure will cut the cooldown time in half. This effect lasts 12 hours and only affects adventures ended during this time.
zombiehand.flavor: The hand of the undead. Do NOT even think about doing what you're thinking about doing.
zombiehand.name: Zombie Hand
